SA_SMOS_O1_CM_HANDLER_URL: URL where the Intent Service pushes new O1 CM intents to SA SMOS's handler (default `http://sa-smos:8000/o1-cm-handler/intents`). Change it if SA SMOS has another address.
SA_SMOS_REPORTS_URL: Base URL MDAF pushes an assurance monitor's reports to (`<base>/monitors/{id}/reports`, call flow 04b; default `http://sa-smos:8000`, https under mTLS). Change it if SA SMOS has another address.
